name: Xi'an NovaStar Tech Co., Ltd.
summary: Xi'an NovaStar Tech Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, designs and develops LED display control solutions in China and internationally. The company offers light-emitting diode (LED) control systems; video controllers, AV over IP systems, media servers, video splicing processors, control and video processors, V-Can software, and visual intelligent control platform; and nova cloud products, such as LED playback control processors, mini LED control PC, multi media player, and LCD controller, as well as Nova cloud services.
